message.source: Stop %1? Every open task is cancelled and no task is handed out again. Member sessions keep running; their current turns finish. A stopped team cannot be started again; use Pause to stop it for a while.

confirmation.text: Stop Orchard? Every open task is cancelled and no task is handed out again. Member sessions keep running; their current turns finish. A stopped team cannot be started again; use Pause to stop it for a while.

rendered.en: Stop Orchard? Every open task is cancelled and no task is handed out again. Member sessions keep running; their current turns finish. A stopped team cannot be started again; use Pause to stop it for a while.
rendered.ru: Остановить команду Orchard? Все открытые задачи будут отменены, и новые задачи больше не будут выдаваться. Сессии участников продолжат работать; их текущие ходы завершатся. Остановленную команду нельзя запустить снова; чтобы остановить её на время, используйте «Приостановить».
